personal.name: Francisco Noletto
personal.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
personal.subTitle: Building premium web applications with modern architecture and high accessibility standards.
personal.bio: I am a passionate software engineer specializing in frontend craftsmanship and robust backend systems. With over 6 years of experience, I focus on creating fast, accessible, and beautiful digital experiences. My architecture values clean code, type safety, and user-centric designs.

description: Architecting modern Angular applications using Signals-based state management, improving rendering performance by 30%.
Developing scalable backend APIs in Node.js and Go to handle high-traffic operations of over 100k daily active users.
Mentoring junior engineers and advocating for strict testing and WCAG accessibility standards across products.
Implemented high-performance PHP/Laravel web portals with search engine optimization, increasing organic traffic by 45%.
Created an interactive drag-and-drop dashboard in ReactJS, significantly reducing administrative task times for client partners.
Managed database optimization, partitioning tables in PostgreSQL to resolve query timeouts under high load.
Built responsive user interfaces for SaaS web applications using Angular and RxJS.
Established a reusable UI component library adhering to semantic HTML principles and accessibility guidelines.
Collaborated with UI/UX designers to translate Figma mockups into interactive animations and responsive views.
